description: This file manages API key rotation logic for a provider, including deduplication of API keys, executing actions with multiple keys, and handling rate limit errors with retries.

methods.name: dedupeApiKeys
methods.description: Removes duplicate and empty API keys from a list.

methods.name: collectProviderApiKeysForExecution
methods.description: Collects and deduplicates API keys for a specified provider, optionally including a primary API key.

methods.name: executeWithApiKeyRotation
methods.description: Executes a given function with each API key in rotation, handling retries and rate limit errors.
